review_scope_note: Unlike prior API-based reviews that saw only the finding text, this audit had full repository access: experiment kernels, archived run logs/CSVs, prior reviews, remediations, and paper/CERTIFICATE.md where applicable. Quantitative claims were checked against primary artifacts; arithmetic and hashes were recomputed where feasible. No computational result was invented.
verification_methods: Checked TG CSV (max ω 2→0.1566, BKM 12.8036) and random 512² log (BKM 1.771399, 531.9 steps/s, NaN=0)
Compared dealias wording to code threshold N/3

claim_reviews.claim: Pseudospectral 2D vorticity-form NS with BKM integral, cuFFT C2C, RK4, fp64.

claim_reviews.evidence: Code uses kmax=(N/3)*dk — the Orszag 2/3 rule threshold is N/3 in frequency index, not 2N/3. Wording is wrong even if intent is standard.

claim_reviews.claim: Random 512² ν=1e-4, 5000 steps: BKM≈1.77, ~532 steps/s, NaN/Inf=0 on RTX 5090.
Throughput 256² = 1108 steps/s; all archived runs NaN-free.
claim_reviews.evidence: No smoke-run log for 1108 steps/s. Separately, bkm_n256_nu1e-03_steps500.csv is a failed NaN run that should be quarantined/labeled.

claim_reviews.claim: No blowup claimed; 2D globally regular; infrastructure certification only.
claim_reviews.evidence: Scope hedges are correct and important.

missing_references: Archive TG smoke log; quarantine failed steps500 CSV
BKM 1984; Orszag 1971; Canuto et al. spectral methods
overall_assessment: Sound certifying infrastructure for 2D pseudospectral NS+BKM with correct TG decay and a clean random-IC run. Dealias wording and a leftover NaN CSV are the main cleanliness issues. Silver is fair after those fixes.
recommendations: Remove or clearly mark the failed steps500 CSV
certification_justification: Standard methods with open code and matching primary CSVs/logs for the cited certifying runs. Not gold: no independent external DNS comparison beyond TG.
